title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.22055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. translated_abstract: 诸如Transformer之类的标准神经架构之所以被选用，是因为它们能通过梯度下降很好地训练，并且在GPU上运行速度快。而在权重空间编程中，大型语言模型（LLM）无需基于梯度的训练即可直接编写目标权重，因此这些理由不再适用。我们还应该继续使用Transformer吗？在最少指导、十个标注示例和一个沙盒环境的条件下（任务主要为多项选择题），我们让三个前沿LLM要么为固定架构生成权重，要么自行设计架构。当可以自由设计时，这三个LLM都将纯文本事实编译成一个由固定程序查询的稀疏表，测试准确率最高达到54.4%。LLM设计的模型比同一LLM所编写的最准确的已发布Transformer取得了更高的测试准确率，而参数量仅约为后者的1/1800。在没有梯度的情况下，它们选择了一种表结构，其中LLM可以说明每个权重的含义……
tldr: 在无需梯度训练的权重空间编程中，三个前沿LLM在自由设计架构时都不约而同地将知识编译为可查询的稀疏表，且其性能以约1/1800的参数量超越了Transformer，表明权重空间编程并不需要Transformer。
en_tdlr: In gradient-free weight-space programming, frontier LLMs spontaneously compile facts into queryable sparse tables that outperform Transformers with ~1,800x fewer parameters, showing weight-space programming doesn't need Transformers.
